content.text: The Real Reason This Problem Exists

The problem exists because the current digital commerce infrastructure is built on a foundation of centralized payment gateways, which are subject to geographic restrictions and platform policies. These gateways are designed to serve the interests of the platforms, not the creators. As a result, creators are forced to rely on these gateways, which limits their ability to sell to international buyers and restricts their freedom to choose how they process payments.
Why the Obvious Fixes Do Not Work

The obvious fixes, such as using Binance P2P or other peer-to-peer payment services, do not work because they are still subject to geographic restrictions and platform policies. These services may allow creators to accept payments in certain currencies, but they do not provide the flexibility and sovereignty that creators need to build a successful digital commerce business. Furthermore, these services often come with high fees and limited features, making them unsuitable for creators who need a robust and scalable payment solution.
The Infrastructure That Solves It at the Base Layer

The infrastructure that solves this problem at the base layer is a sovereign digital commerce stack that is built on a foundation of decentralized and blockchain-based technologies. This stack includes tools such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, which provide creators with the flexibility and sovereignty they need to build a successful digital commerce business. With this stack, creators can process payments in any currency, accept payments from anywhere in the world, and maintain complete control over their data and customer relationships.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can break free from platform restrictions and geographic barriers and build a successful digital commerce business that is truly sovereign.
How to Implement the Solution Today

To implement this solution today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit is available for instant download and provides creators with everything they need to get started. Creators can then deploy their stack using the instructions provided in the kit, and start processing payments in minutes. With this solution, creators can finally break free from platform restrictions and geographic barriers, and build a successful digital commerce business that is truly sovereign.
What Your Store Looks Like After the Fix

After implementing the solution, creators can expect their store to be fully functional and scalable, with the ability to process payments in any currency and accept payments from anywhere in the world. Creators will have complete control over their data and customer relationships, and will be able to maintain a robust and scalable payment solution. With this solution, creators can finally achieve the freedom and sovereignty they need to build a successful digital commerce business.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Binance P2P and other peer-to-peer payment services are not suitable for creators who need a robust and scalable payment solution.

This solution is not only relevant to Cameroon, but also to other African countries that face similar restrictions on payment gateways. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, and Zimbabwe can also break free from platform restrictions and geographic barriers and build successful digital commerce businesses. Additionally, creators who are interested in learning more about the solutions and resources available can visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and explore the Complete Builder Kit.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
